observations: A large black cat-shaped form sits centered against a pale cream and warm amber wash background, with pointed ears at the top and a raised tail visible at right.
The face area contains two square-spiral eye shapes outlined in blue and red, and a row of blue rectangular teeth, all set within the dark mass of the head.
Loose gold and white looping lines overlay the entire figure, while the body is filled with dense gray cross-hatching and three vertical white stripes.
reading: A black cat-shaped mass dominates the center, its bulk built from layered gray cross-hatching rather than solid fill. The face holds two blue-outlined square spirals for eyes and a blue-toothed mouth — forms that read as mask-like rather than naturalistic. Gold loops drift across the head and body like loose wire, giving the dark form an unsettled quality. The warm amber wash behind it keeps the mood from turning fully ominous.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #254 and nnxyz nnotb #256. Where #254 fills its space with a dense multi-figure scene in saturated color, #255 pulls back to a single dark form against open ground — quieter but no less layered.

connections.reason: Both works place a dark animal-shaped head at center with square-spiral eye forms outlined in blue and red, making the eye construction the clearest formal echo across the two pieces.

lookingQuestion: Where do the gold looping lines begin and end relative to the body's edges — do they stay inside the form, cross its outline, or both?
